title: GBA1 in Parkinson’s disease: past, present and future
title_zh: 帕金森病中的GBA1：过去、现在与未来
abstract: Abstract GBA1 variants represent some of the most important genetic risk factors for Parkinson’s disease (PD), present in a substantial proportion of patients across populations. This review provides a comprehensive overview of the field, tracing the historical path from the first description of Gaucher disease (GD) in 1882 to the recognition of GBA1 as a key contributor to PD risk, highlighting major scientific and translational milestones along the way, summarizing current understanding of the biological mechanisms linking GBA1 to PD, including both loss-of-function and gain-of-function hypotheses, and discussing how reduced glucocerebrosidase (GCase) activity may lead to α-synuclein accumulation and neurodegeneration. Remaining gaps in knowledge, especially regarding downstream lipidomic effects and cell type-specific mechanisms, are emphasized as key priorities for future research. Clinical and translational advances are also examined, including the development of GCase-targeted therapies such as small molecules, chaperones, substrate reduction therapies and gene-based approaches. Outcomes from recent and ongoing clinical trials are discussed, highlighting both promising strategies and notable failures that inform our evolving understanding of disease biology. In addition, the heterogeneity of PD is addressed, together with the importance of stratifying patients based on genetic background. Finally, critical challenges and future directions are outlined, including the need for precision medicine approaches based on variant-specific mechanisms, improved biomarkers to define true GBA1-associated PD and optimized clinical trial design. Ultimately, coordinated, open-science efforts and large-scale collaborative frameworks are proposed to be essential in accelerating discovery and translating mechanistic insights into effective disease-modifying therapies.
abstract_zh: 摘要 GBA1变异是帕金森病（PD）最重要的遗传风险因素之一，在各人群中相当比例的患者中存在。本综述全面概述了该领域，回溯了从1882年高雪病（GD）首次被描述以来的历史进程，直至GBA1被认定为PD风险的关键贡献因素，并突出沿途的主要科学和转化里程碑；总结了目前关于将GBA1与PD联系起来的生物学机制的理解，包括功能丧失和功能获得假说，以及葡萄糖脑苷脂酶（GCase）活性降低如何导致α-突触核蛋白积累和神经退化。强调了关于下游脂质组效应和细胞类型特异性机制等知识空白，将其作为未来研究的关键优先事项。还考察了临床和转化进展，包括针对GCase的疗法开发，如小分子、伴侣分子、基底物减少疗法和基因治疗方法。讨论了最近和正在进行的临床试验结果，突出既有前景的策略也有显著失败，这些结果为我们不断发展的疾病生物学理解提供了依据。此外，还讨论了PD的异质性以及根据遗传背景对患者进行分层的重要性。最后，概述了关键挑战和未来方向，包括需要基于变异特异性机制的精准医学方法、改进的生物标志物以界定真正的GBA1相关PD以及优化临床试验设计。最终，提出协调的开放科学努力和大规模协作框架对于加速发现并将机制洞察转化为有效的疾病修饰性疗法至关重要。
